احتكرن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَرْنَ (iḥtakarna) /iħ.ta.kar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اُحْتُكِرْنَ (uḥtukirna) /uħ.tu.kir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اِحْتَكِرْنَ (iḥtakirna) /iħ.ta.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
